name: codex-ladder
description: Holds Codex CLI runs to an effort ladder: max only with your one-shot grant, low only via --profile docs, escalate a tier instead of retrying, and briefs need DONE, verification and a stop condition.

defaultEffort.title: Codex default effort
defaultEffort.description: The model_reasoning_effort in your ~/.codex/config.toml (what a run gets when it names none).

briefTemplate.title: Brief template path
briefTemplate.description: Optional. A brief that lacks parts is pointed here.

blockFastTier.title: Block the fast/priority service tier
blockFastTier.description: Denies runs that ask for the fast or priority service tier.
